extracted.name: Garden Tomato Salsa
extracted.description: This garden tomato salsa recipe is made with fresh tomatoes, onion, bell pepper, cilantro, pickled jalapeños, fresh lime, red wine vinegar, and oil.
ingredient_lines: 5 slices pickled jalapeno peppers, or to taste
instruction_lines: Place onion, bell pepper, cilantro, and jalapeños in the bowl of a food processor; pulse until finely chopped. Add tomatoes; pulse several times until tomatoes are coarsely chopped. Transfer to a bowl with a tight-fitting lid.
Whisk olive oil, red wine vinegar, lime juice, and salt together in a small bowl until vinaigrette well combined.
Pour vinaigrette over tomato mixture; stir well. Cover; refrigerate before serving for at least 1 hour.
